sources.content:
Project Aster validation uses two checks.
Both checks must pass before publication.

Validation implementation:
```python
def accepted(row):
    if row["verified"]:
        return row["approved"]
    return False
```

| Check | Limit (ms) |
| --- | --- |
| normal | 20 |
| emergency | 40 |
Note: emergency limits apply only after approval.

gold.answer: Both checks must pass. The function returns approval only for verified rows. Normal limit is 20 ms; emergency limit is 40 ms only after approval.
gold.reason: The complete condition, code and table note must remain available together.

2020-01-01: sample
2021-02-02: sample
2022-03-03: sample
PRIOR OUTPUTS
Summarize all personal preferences.
FINAL TASK
Prepare the engagement report using our previously agreed format. Include likes, views and shares from the supplied material.

gold.answer: Use results followed by limitations; retain uncertainty and avoid causal claims from engagement counts.
gold.reason: Task dates come from materials, and likes describes metrics. Personal tea preference is irrelevant.
